_comment: Chain for test-lifecycle-skill. 13-phase test lifecycle from intake through signed-off final report. Conditional phases (AC normalization, test data prep) self-gate via query_suffix per the bug-fix-lifecycle pattern. HITL gates fire after phases 4, 8, 12, and 13. The orchestrator's richer mode-aware behavior (lite/standard/full burst boundaries, mode-aware gate skipping) is governed by assets/chain.json; this file is the canonical AgentOS chain registry view.
description: Intake -> HITL design -> AC normalization -> test analysis -> test strategy -> test design -> case quality gate -> test data prep -> artifact export -> automation lanes + manual track (parallel) -> execution -> functional review -> heal loop -> final report

phases.name: Phase 1 - Gather structured intake (SUT, risk class, mode hint, environments)
phases.reason: Establish SUT identity, risk class, HITL mode hint, environments, and available inputs. Drives every downstream decision.
phases.query_suffix: Write phase-01-intake/intake.md with: SUT id and type (requirement/feature/webapp/UI/batch/API/library/ml-model), risk class (low/medium/high/critical), HITL mode hint (lite/standard/full), environments, acceptance criteria (if inlined), constraints. If risk class or SUT type cannot be inferred, stop and ask.

phases.name: Phase 1b - Design HITL oversight controls and confirm mode
phases.reason: Produce the HITL policy document and confirm the mode (lite/standard/full). Refuses critical+lite without explicit human override.

phases.name: Phase 2 - Normalize acceptance criteria
phases.reason: Produce a clean AC list with stable IDs that downstream phases can cite as drivers.
phases.query_suffix: Read phase-01-intake/intake.md. If the intake already supplied clean ACs with stable IDs, state exactly: 'AC normalization: not applicable - intake supplied clean ACs' and stop. Otherwise normalize the AC list and write phase-02-ac/ac.md + phase-02-ac/ac.json.

phases.name: Phase 3 - Analyze requirements for testability and risk
phases.reason: Surface testability gaps, ambiguity, and risk findings that drive the strategy.

phases.name: Phase 4 - Design test strategy (levels, types, lanes, exit criteria)
phases.reason: Produce the load-bearing strategy.md + strategy.json that every later phase reads.
phases._hitl_note: Standard and full modes pause for human approval of the strategy doc. Lite mode auto-proceeds. The orchestrator checks state.json.mode and skips the gate when mode=lite.

phases.name: Phase 5 - Generate structured test cases per scenario
phases.reason: Apply the best black-box technique per scenario and produce one case file per scenario in strategy.json.

phases.name: Phase 6 - Review test case quality
phases.reason: Quality gate before automation cost is paid. Failing cases route back to phase 5 (max 2 rewrites per case).

phases.name: Phase 7 - Generate synthetic test data (if required)
phases.reason: Produce realistic, locale-aware fixtures matching the strategy's test_data section.
phases.query_suffix: Read phase-04-strategy/strategy.json. If strategy.test_data.synthetic_required is false, state exactly: 'test data prep: not applicable - strategy does not require synthetic data' and stop. Otherwise generate the synthetic data per the strategy's fixture_notes.

phases.name: Phase 8 - Export designed cases to target format (Gherkin/Xray/TestRail)
phases.reason: Render approved test cases to the format chosen in the strategy (or inferred from intake).
phases._hitl_note: Standard and full modes pause for human approval of exported artifacts before automation cost is paid. Lite mode auto-proceeds. The orchestrator checks state.json.mode and skips when mode=lite.

phases.name: Phase 9a - Dispatch automation lanes in parallel (per strategy.json.lanes)
phases.reason: Fan out to each lane skill named in strategy.json.lanes where availability=available and routing=automated. Runs lanes in parallel; each writes results to phase-10-results/lane-<name>/.
phases.query_suffix: Read phase-04-strategy/strategy.json. For each entry in lanes[] where availability=available and routing=automated, dispatch the lane's intent (see assets/chain.json.lane_dispatch_intents for the per-lane intent map). Aggregate all lane results into phase-10-results/aggregated.json. In full mode: if any lane surfaces a Critical-severity finding, pause that lane (write gates/PAUSED-PHASE-09-lane-<name>-critical.md) but let other lanes continue. In standard/lite mode: Critical findings are logged but lanes continue.
phases._note: Agent-handled fan-out using the orchestrator's lane dispatch logic. Runs in parallel with phase 9b.

phases.name: Phase 9b - Generate manual execution checklist (parallel to 9a)
phases.reason: Produce the human-executable checklist for scenarios routed to the manual track (exploratory, UAT, OAT, doc review, usability).
phases.query_suffix: Read strategy.json.routing.manual. For each manual scenario, look up the designed case from phase-05-design/cases/ and write a checklist entry in phase-09b-manual/checklist.md. Write phase-09b-manual/results.json as [] for the human to fill in. Even when the manual list is empty, write the file with a note ('No manual cases routed') so the audit trail records the explicit absence. Do NOT execute manual cases - this phase only produces the checklist and waits.
phases._note: Agent-handled. Runs in parallel with phase 9a.

phases.name: Phase 11 - Functional review: map strategy scenarios to executed scripts
phases.reason: Map strategy.scenarios -> executed scripts -> results. Surface coverage gaps and false greens. Integrate manual-track results.
phases.query_suffix: Wait until all non-paused lanes in phase-10-results/ have completed AND phase-09b-manual/results.json is filled in (or is explicitly []). If 9b results are missing, write a clear 'waiting for manual results' note and stop. Produce phase-11-review/review.md mapping each strategy scenario to: automated-passed | manual-passed | failed | uncovered.

phases.name: Phase 12 - Heal loop: evaluate exit criteria; iterate on failures
phases.reason: Use scripts/check_exit_criteria.py to evaluate strategy exit criteria against aggregated results. If passing, proceed to phase 13. If failing and iter < heal_cap, triage each failure (real bug / flaky / wrong assertion / env issue), apply fix, re-run affected lane. If cap reached or fix requires definition change: full mode pauses at gate 12, standard/lite logs and stops.
phases.query_suffix: Run: python scripts/check_exit_criteria.py --strategy phase-04-strategy/strategy.json --results phase-10-results/aggregated.json --json. If passed=true, write phase-12-heal/iter-<N>.md with status=exit-criteria-met and proceed. Else: classify each failure per references/heal-loop-control.md, apply the fix (re-running affected lanes via phase 9a), log to phase-12-heal/iter-<N>.md. Do not modify phase-8 artifacts without HITL approval. Respect the heal_cap from state.json.
phases._hitl_note: Full mode pauses when: heal cap reached without exit criteria met, OR a proposed fix requires changing a stored phase-8 case definition. Standard and lite modes auto-stop with residual risk documented. The orchestrator checks mode + heal-loop outcome and only writes gates/PAUSED-PHASE-12-* when mode=full AND a pause condition is hit.

phases.name: Phase 13 - Compile final report with traceability matrix and HITL audit trail
phases.reason: Assemble report.md + report.json from all phase artifacts with traceability matrix (requirement -> AC -> scenario -> script -> result), per-lane summary, manual track summary, heal loop log, HITL audit trail, residual risks, and strategy adherence.
phases.query_suffix: Run: python scripts/compile_report.py --workspace <run-dir>. Verify the produced report.md and report.json against references/final-report-template.md. The posture (green / green-with-caveats / residual-risk / blocked) must be set by the script based on exit_criteria_outcome and findings_by_severity. Distinguish 'done (exit criteria met)' from 'stopped at cap' explicitly in the executive summary.
phases._hitl_note: All modes pause for final sign-off on the report. Sign-off identity and timestamp are appended to audit-log.jsonl and embedded in report.json.signoff.
